verdict.rationale: sevDesk offers a REST API with tokens, so asking whether credentials can be scoped for an agent is a fair question. The evidence never describes scoped, permission-limited, or per-agent tokens. It only notes that API tokens have an infinite lifetime and recommends a separate trial account for testing, which is a workaround rather than least-privilege credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
